newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan construction shares up on bargain-hunting.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan construction shares up on bargain-hunting.

text.p: Taiwan's construction stocks rose on bargain hunting in late Monday trade, helping pull the market higher, brokers said.
With 60 minutes left, the entire construction sector was up 1.36 percent, compared with the main index's 0.49 percent rise.
Pacific Construction was up 50 cents or 2.12 percent to T$24.1 and Delpha Construction jumped T$1.6 or 5.28 percent to T$31.9.
Some analysts expect the construction industry to start to recover in early 1997 after years of recession but brokers noted Monday's buying interest came mostly from bargain-hunters.

"The bargain-hunting seems to come from short-term oriented investors who are not that interested in long-term investment, therefore selling pressure will emerge soon," said Tsao Chung-ping, an analyst of Ting Kong Securities.
